Write a geocode lineage row to DuckDB

Source: R/db-geocode.R
db_write_geocode_lineage.Rd

Records one lineage row per write into geocode_lineage. The input x may be an alprek_geocode_clean, alprek_geocode_reconciled, alprek_geocode_master, or alprek_geocode_panel. For panels, one row per geocode_run_id in panel$binding_log is appended.

Lineage columns:

  • geocode_run_id (character)

  • source (character; e.g., "melissa")

  • cycle_year (character)

  • snapshot_date (character / ISO date)

  • file_sha256 (character)

  • git_sha (character)

  • n_rows (integer)

  • n_followup (integer; counts when known)

  • distance_threshold_rules (character)

  • flat_threshold_m (integer)

  • written_at (character timestamp)

Usage

db_write_geocode_lineage(conn, x, run_id = NULL)

Arguments

conn

A DBI connection.

x

One of alprek_geocode_clean, alprek_geocode_reconciled, alprek_geocode_master, or alprek_geocode_panel.

run_id

Optional character — override the derived geocode_run_id (only honored when x is non-panel).

Value

Invisible character "geocode_lineage".
